newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean government threatens strike counter steps.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean government threatens strike counter steps.

text.p: South Korea will take "stern countermeasures" against illegal strikes, a statement from the prime minister's office said on Thursday.
It gave no details of steps to be taken against union bodies that have issued strike calls to almost two million workers in protest at the passage on Thursday of a controversial new labour law.

"The government expresses serious worries over the impact on the national economy and has decided to take stern countermeasures against these illegal actions," the statement from Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung's office said.
"The government will make efforts to prevent stoppages from resulting in inconvenience to people's lives and take emergency steps (to protect) infrastructure and public utilities."
The statement was issued during a meeting of deputy ministers to discuss the crisis.
